page.layout: One printed page, single text column with a decorative fleuron at the top; brace-grouped dedicatee lists with small marginal-style text to the right of the brace groups (treated as notes beside their names); no running head, no page number printed in the text block (faint page number "21" in the top-left corner is show-through and omitted); no catchword or signature. Show-through text from the reverse page is ignored.

main_text.l: Venerabili atq; spectabili Domino Decano, reliquisq; Dominis
Pastoribus Vigilantissimis, Theologo spectatissimo p. t. Rectori
Gymnasiarchae meritissimo, adeoq; toti venerando coetui Ec-
clesiastico, Dominis suis Mecaenatibus, fautoribus atq; pro-
motoribus, nullo honoris & obsequij genere satis demerendis.
DN. JOHANNI GEORGIO IM HOFF, Reipubl. Bernensis
Senatori prudentissimo, fautori suo nullo non honoris
DN. DAVIDI à RÜTHI, DN. JACOBO WYSSIO, DN.
DN. MAURITIO RINGIERO, DN. JOHANNI ROLLIERO,
DN. DANIELI HEMMANO, DN. DAVIDI à RÜTHI,
Hasce studiorum Theologicorum primitias, dicat; dedicat

marginalia.note: Ducentum viris dignissimis patriaeque salutis studiosissimis fautoribus ac cognatis suis omni officij genere demerendis
Illi in Lozwyl huic in Diesbach, verbi divini praeconibus indefessis cognatis ac benefactoribus omni honoris genere prosequendis.
Illi vineae Dei in Rhynach cultori indefesso, huic Not. publ. civi Reipub. Bernensis perito, Affinibus suis dilectissimis.

page.notes: Printed names and dedicatees are set in small capitals; the brace-grouped text at right is treated as marginal notes. Ornamental fleuron at top. The word "Rhynach" in the brace note is in black letter and is rendered as printed; uncertain readings: "Lozwyl" and "Diesbach" as printed. Several line-ends are unclear in the scan.
